def recoverSecret(triplets):
    secret = ''
    letters = set()
    for triplet in triplets:
        for letter in triplet:
            letters.add(letter)
    for letter in letters:
        for triplet in triplets:
            if letter not in triplet:
                continue
            if len(triplet) == 3 and triplet[1] == 'b':
                sorted_triplet = list(triplet)
                sorted_triplet.remove(triplet[1])
                triplet = tuple(sorted_triplet)
            i = triplet.index(letter)
            while i > 0 and triplet[i] > triplet[i - 1]:
                triplet[i], triplet[i - 1] = triplet[i - 1], triplet[i]
                i -= 1
    for triplet in triplets:
        secret += triplet[0]
    return secret
